Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: when the new and old iPhones differ in size, you need to buy a new case.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, a new case is almost a necessity—but two accessory manufacturers don't agree, and one is betting heavily on this prediction...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, saying the product is already available at Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging is labeled in English and French:

for iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely convinced, adding "a bit early." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad (which specializes in anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones) said his suppliers told him the same thing.

iPhone Pro thickness rumors vary

Last year, leakers pointed out that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. The report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but information from iPhone suppliers indicates that the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

This trend seems to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers share the same view—some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide dimensional information to partner case manufacturers in advance so that third-party cases can launch alongside new iPhones. On the other hand, accessory manufacturers have also placed production orders based purely on rumors, and sometimes they get it wrong. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
